name: 0000-MAIN
description: Initializes processing by opening files, starts fetching customer data, and performs final cleanup operations.

algorithm.details: Opens a specified file for reading or writing.
Transfers control to 1000-FETCH-CUSTOMERS to retrieve customer data.
Closes the file after operations are complete.
Returns control to the operating system.

sideEffects.description: Writes report data to the output file.
